entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [API Proposal]: VectorXXX types, ISpanFormattable, and other interfaces (debugging QoL mostly) #121100
  • [API Proposal]: ExecutionContext.Default #121098

Closed

  • Add DebuggerDisplay to Activity and friends #88332
    Future
  • Return true when input object is null! #121099
  • Consider propagating regex comments to source-generated code #69616
    Future
  • ConfigurationSection.SerializeSection() does not populate collections #43964
  • Side-effects of precise static constructors not respected by optimizations #121066
  • Linux - build fails when using generated Sources from NuGet package cswin32 #121101
  • [android] failed to build android on macos #120616
    Future
  • [Analyzer Proposal]: Recommend using JsonElement.Parse #111957
    Future
  • PLINQ query crashes a .NET Core 6 application due to unhandled InvalidCastException thrown from System.Threading.Tasks.Task.RunContinuations. #83520
    Future

PullRequests

Created

  • Handle clang/gcc defining "unix" during compilation #121097
    arch-wasm, area-Diagnostics-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • [wasm] Bump chrome for testing - linux: 141.0.7390.122, windows: 142.0.7444.52 #121096
    arch-wasm, area-Infrastructure-mono

Merged

  • Fix documentation to clarify culture name usage for case-insensitive comparisons in GeneratedRegexAttribute #121073
    area-System.Text.RegularExpressions, community-contribution
  • Add DebuggerDisplay and DebuggerTypeProxy to Activity and related types #121054
    area-System.Diagnostics.Activity, 11.0.0
  • Fix #121066: Mark INITCLASS helpers as mutating heap to respect static constructor side-effects #121069
  • [browser] build browserhost in host.native subset #120298
    arch-wasm, area-Host, os-browser, 11.0.0

Updated

  • Convert pointers to span in System.Net.Primitives #121016
    area-System.Net, reduce-unsafe
  • Fix Options validation source generator to exclude instance name from error messages #121030
    area-Extensions-Options, 11.0.0
  • Add MethodDesc comments #121094
    area-VM-coreclr
  • [release/10.0] Fix CORDBG_E_MODULE_NOT_LOADED error in func-eval #121087
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr, 10.0.0
  • Fix GetSystemTimeZone to return filtered list #121095
    area-System.DateTime, 11.0.0
  • [WIP] Add hexadecimal float/double parsing and formatting support (IEEE 754:2008) - API surface only #120637
    area-System.Runtime
  • Add generic And<T> and Or<T> methods to System.Threading.Interlocked #120978
    area-System.Threading, reduce-unsafe
  • Fix primitive converters to honor JsonNumberHandling when obtained via GetConverter #120805
    area-System.Text.Json
  • [browser][coreCLR] async main, thread pool, timers #120976
    arch-wasm, area-System.Threading, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • [browser][coreCLR] enable bigint #121025
    arch-wasm, area-Host, os-browser, 11.0.0
  • Upgrade build to use CMake 3.26 #120823
    area-Infrastructure
  • Improve `ImmutableArrayExtensions.SequenceEqual` #118932
    NO-MERGE, area-System.Collections, community-contribution, 11.0.0
  • Improve code coverage for System.Security.Cryptography.Xml (71.85% → 75.08%) #120640
    area-System.Security, test-enhancement
  • Fix `Version.Parse` to show original input in `FormatException` message when input has trailing dots #121055
    area-System.Runtime
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #121084
    area-codeflow
